description: ⚠️ Destructive: Permanently delete one or more Cloud Cache manual backup files. Backups are identified by instance number plus file name (from ncloud_list_cache_manual_backup_details), not by a backup ID. Set confirm=true to execute.

cloudCacheInstanceNo.description: Cloud Cache instance number the backups belong to

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute the destructive operation

fileNameList.description: Backup file names to delete (e.g. ['20220315', '20220322']) — from ncloud_list_cache_manual_backup_details

name: ncloud_delete_cache_manual_backup
